CheckTitle: Ensure IAM policies that allow full administrative privileges are not attached (customer-managed policies)
Description: Customer-managed IAM policies that grant full administrative privileges (Action: '*' and Resource: '*') must not be attached to any user, group, or role. Customer-managed policies with admin privileges often bypass standard security reviews applied to AWS managed policies.
Risk: Customer-managed admin policies can be crafted to grant unrestricted access while appearing less risky than the AdministratorAccess AWS managed policy. Attached admin policies grant the same full-account control as AdministratorAccess.
Remediation: Audit all customer-managed policies for statements with Action: '*' or Action: 'iam:*' combined with Resource: '*'. Replace with scoped policies. Detach over-privileged policies from all principals.
SeverityBasis: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0 Control 1.16 (Level 1); AWS Security Hub FSBP IAM.16; full admin privilege attachment violates least privilege and enables direct account takeover
AuthoritativeSource: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0; AWS Security Hub FSBP
